title: Lightbox Animation: Senior Storyboard Artist
text: Headquarters: Córdoba, Andalusia, Spain URL: https://lbox.es Your mission Knock, knock...Any Lightboxer in the room? If you are passionate about 3D animated films and want to create magic cinematographic, you can´t let this opportunity go! We are looking for a talented ​ Senior Storyboard Artist with enthusiasm to join our great team on the exciting new project, Animated Feature TAD 4!! ​You will be responsible for drawing a scene-by-scene visual story based on script. First of all, you're probably interested in knowing that...we offer 100% remote work! WE NEED YOU TO BE ABLE TO DO: Illustrate the narrative, plan shots, and draw panels to demonstrate action and maintain continuity between scenes. Have a great sense of visual storytelling. Meet with creative supervisors to discuss objectives of storyboard; what is desired or to be achieved, receiving written and verbal description of a sequence. Create quick thumbnail sketches through to finished detailed storyboard panels. Create storyboards by implementing storytelling objectives. Illustrate script pages and come up with story ideas. Pitch Storyboards when required. Work with Director and Supervisor to define staging and camera action. Develop character personality and dramatic/comedic action. Ensure quality and style of show is consistently achieved in storyboard work. Meet all deadlines as determined by the Production Team and Supervisor. Think about what the writer is actually trying to say and how best to say it, every choice you make has an impact! Replace words with visuals coherently and clearly, thinking about editing or animation limitations. Ability to work autonomously and independently in a fully remote environment, with that comes the supreme individual responsibility to prioritize and manage multiple tasks and maintain your own initiative. Excellent communications skills. Great team player, create a collaborative and welcoming environment. Proven ability to meet deadlines, prioritize workload and within budgets, adhere to the production schedule and deliver completed assignments on time. Align with the style, sensibility of the project and the Director vision. WE WILL MAKE THE PERFECT MATCH IF YOU HAVE: 5+ years of professional experience from either animation TV series or feature animation movie. Practical knowledge of cinematic language, acting, staging and composition. Ability to align with style and sensibility of feature, able to express story and character emotions through drawings. Strong storytelling abilities to feature character, emotion and movement. Ability to invent action and express it through drawing. Strong knowledge in narrative and filmmaking. Knowledge of Blender is a plus. Ability to take feedback constructively and implement it effectively, to reach the quality desired. Anticipation and quick reaction for problem solving. Demonstrate great autonomy and proactivity in your work. Great attention to detail. Outstanding interpersonal and collaborative skills. Do you think we fit? Well, keep reading. WHAT WILL YOU FIND AT LIGHTBOX? We have a GREAT TEAM, taking animation to another level! Our pillars are: Strong passion : We are proactive with a positive working attitude, we continue to create successful films that conquer children and adults, so we need the motivation and energy of the best creative minds. Behind the scenes: Lightbox has an exciting mission: to bring incredible stories to life! We are happy and proud with giving the best possible value to the projects and continue achieving success. Nice working schedule from 8h to 16h, Monday to Friday, with some flexibility. 22 days working days annual holidays. title: Notice: Frequent manual updates across platforms until v1.8.0 release
text: I am aware that frequent upstream updates to Electron and Chromium (often arriving every other day) currently require users across all platforms to manually re-download and reinstall Mise Browser to keep everything running smoothly. I recognise that having to constantly reinstall updates is frustrating and disrupts your workflow. I am actively working on a comprehensive packaging overhaul for the upcoming **v1.8.0** release to streamline this process. *** * **Current status:** Upstream system Electron updates or base runtime revisions can cause runtime and ABI mismatches immediately after system upgrades. * **Current workaround:** Until v1.8.0, you must pull and reinstall the latest Mise release / package whenever Electron or system dependencies update. * **Current status:** Security patches and rapid upstream Electron cycles require manually downloading and executing the latest installer or updating the portable binary folder. * **Current workaround:** Grab the newest setup executable from the Releases page when a new release is posted to ensure Chromium security patches are applied. * **Current status:** Due to frequent runtime bumps, users must manually replace the `.app` bundle in `/Applications` with each new release build. * **Current workaround:** Download the latest DMG / archive from GitHub Releases and overwrite your existing installation. *** The **v1.8.0** release focuses directly on resolving this update friction across all operating systems: * Streamlined distribution workflows. * Improved update mechanisms to eliminate repetitive manual re-installations. * Synchronised runtime packaging so you spend time browsing rather than maintaining your browser. Testing for v1.8.0 is currently underway across all environments to guarantee stability, security, and performance. I appreciate your patience while this testing is carried out. Please hold tight and bear with me for just a little longer whilst we polish and validate v1.8.0. Thank you for testing Mise and for your continued support!
